specs.英文简介: The Kodak Disc 3600 used disc film, was introduced in 1986, and was powered by two standard AA size batteries,[http://kodak.3106.net/index.php?p=205&cam=1104 Kodak Disc 3600] at [http://kodak.3106.net/index.php Kodak Classics] unlike many of the Kodak disc cameras which had an internal battery the user couldn't replace.
